FINANCIAL PERFORMANCE – Q2 and H1 FY27 STANDALONE
Q2 FY27 Performance:
• Net Sales at Rs 3,982 Cr grew by 21.7% with Underlying Volume Growth (UVG) of 10.7%.
• Consumer and Bazaar (‘C&B’) revenue grew by 20.7% with UVG of 11.1%.
• Business to Business (‘B2B’) revenue grew by 21.8% with UVG of 9.2%.
• EBITDA margin was 20.4% despite input cost headwinds.
• PAT grew by 10.4%.
H1 FY27 Performance:
• Net Sales at Rs 8,219 Cr grew by 22.0% with UVG of 11.0%.
• EBITDA margin at 23.5%, with EBITDA growing 14%. Timely pricing actions and disciplined cost management,
enabled the Company to absorb the impact of input cost inflation.
• PAT grew by 19.5%.
